scope: Repository audit and independently proposed market-sector-stock analysis. Not a live market ranking, causal model, production integration or return validation.

webSources.supports: Free-float adjusted shares and divisor maintenance; sector returns or total market cap are not exact index attribution.
webSources.limits: CSI300 methodology only; each other benchmark needs its own applicable methodology and effective data.

webSources.supports: Relative to a selected benchmark; relative strength and its momentum differ. Idealized rotation is not guaranteed.
webSources.limits: Reference only; independent return-difference charts must not be represented as proprietary JdK RRG indicators.

webSources.supports: Advances minus declines counts each stock equally, unlike capitalization-weighted price indexes.
webSources.limits: Our proposed normalized breadth is independently defined; it is not the accumulated AD Line.

webSources.supports: Dynamic universes and point-in-time data; current constituent backtests introduce survivorship bias.
webSources.limits: Reporting lag cannot reconstruct missing historical membership. The plan blocks such historical claims.

repositorySources.supports: The industry listing maps f104/f105 to advancing/declining counts and f128/f136/f140 to the reported leading stock and return/code; these are provider fields, not index weight or contribution.
repositorySources.limits: Source and license inspected only. No installed SDK, copied code, live API availability, historical membership or market-data redistribution authorization established.
